description: Changes an existing automation’s name or description, and nothing else: what it does and its settings stay as they are. connection_id puts an automation made before numbers, which runs on every number, on one WhatsApp number, once; one that has a number keeps it. Its refunds setting (whether its refund steps wait for a person, run on their own or are off, shown with its details) is changed by a person in the Cosend dashboard, and a call that sends it is refused. Returns the automation.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number for an automation that has none and runs on every number. Accepted once; an automation that has a number keeps it, and another one (or null) is refused. The value it already has, null included, changes nothing.

refunds.description: This automation’s own rule for its refund steps (a step whose action a person approves: WooCommerce’s Refund the order, or a payment service’s Refund a payment). ask_first: each refund waits for a person under Approvals (the automation waits for it first). on_its_own: it refunds with no person checking it. off: it does not refund, and saving a version with a refund step is refused. ask_first until set. An owner or an admin changes it.

name: update_automation_details
title: Rename an automation
